description: For each patient in the healthcare records system, return the first and the last recorded diagnosis code across their visits ordered by visit_ts (ties by visit_id), ignoring visits with a NULL diagnosis_code, together with the total number of visits (including those without a diagnosis) and a flag indicating whether the diagnosis changed. Patients whose visits all lack a diagnosis have NULL first/last and diagnosis_changed = FALSE. Exclude deceased patients. Output columns: patient_id (INT64), first_diagnosis (STRING), last_diagnosis (STRING), visit_count (INT64), diagnosis_changed (BOOL). One row per patient, sorted by patient_id.

diagnosis_code.description: Diagnosis code; NULL for routine check-ups

edge_cases: Latest visit has NULL diagnosis; last_diagnosis must be the last non-NULL value (B20)
visit_count includes visits without a diagnosis
Patient with a single visit has first = last and diagnosis_changed = FALSE
Patient with only NULL diagnoses yields NULLs and diagnosis_changed = FALSE (not NULL)
common_failure_modes: FM4: LAST_VALUE() with the default frame (UNBOUNDED PRECEDING to CURRENT ROW) returns the current row's value, not the partition's last
FM5: Without IGNORE NULLS the last diagnosis is NULL for patient 1
FM3: Selecting window results without DISTINCT/GROUP BY returns one row per visit instead of per patient
